title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00074 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:30: Continued l/d jet sub/torque tool BHA. Cleaned and cleared drill floor. Meanwhile prepared to run spear BHA
00:30 - 00:45: Performed TBT for RIH with spear to fish casing stump and tie-back adapter.
00:45 - 01:15: P/u spear assy and set in slips. Removed thread sleeve from adjustable sub on the grapple from previous fishing run).
01:15 - 02:00: RIH w/spear to 130 mmd. Engaged spear inside casing stump.
02:00 - 02:45: POOH w/spear and fish. Observed 2 ton overpull. Secured fish in slips and released spear.
02:45 - 03:00: Performed TBT for l/o fish
03:00 - 03:45: L/o fish and r/b spear
03:45 - 04:00: Cleaned and cleared drill floor. Meanwhile prepared equiment to run guns.
04:00 - 04:15: Performed TBT for handling guns
04:15 - 05:15: P/u and m/u gun BHA
05:15 - 05:45: RIH w/guns to 145,3 mmd
05:45 - 06:15: Confirmed line up and closed BOP. B/o TDS and dropped ball. M/u TDS and started pumping with low rate. Guns fired at 139 bar. Continued circulating with 900 LPM 6 bar. Lost 8m3 after firing guns.
06:15 - 06:45: Circulated b/u through choke. MAX 1 gas measured on mud logging gas trap. No h2s detected.
06:45 - 07:15: Flow checked well for 5min through fully open choke, static. Opened BOP and flow checked well on TT for 10min, static.

08:00 - 08:15: L/d perforation BHA

08:30 - 11:00: P/u taper mill assy and removed stab and DC from taper mill run. P/u casing hanger mill and m/u same.
